subject.title: fix(ui): prevent Workboard dashboard verification races

question: Should this maintainer-labeled test-stability change merge with `updateComplete` as the Workboard dashboard helper’s canonical readiness boundary?
rationale: The patch is intentionally test-only and has positive behavior evidence, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision on the lifecycle contract.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Confirm that the component’s first completed Lit update includes synchronous board-provider acquisition, then merge this focused test stabilization.

options.title: Request a narrower readiness contract
options.body: Keep the PR open and replace the wait with a component-level readiness signal only if provider acquisition can continue asynchronously after the first update.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm that the component’s first completed Lit update includes synchronous board-provider acquisition, then merge this focused test stabilization.
